title: Agents
subtitle: Manage your OpenClaw agents and their channel ownership

list.title: Agent list
list.description: Each agent can inherit the default model and own its own set of channel assignments.

empty.title: No agents to show yet
empty.description: Create a new agent to split conversations and channel ownership by role.

gatewayWarning: Gateway is offline. Agent and channel ownership will resume syncing once the connection is restored.

createDialog.title: Add Agent
createDialog.description: Create a new agent by name. ClawClaw will copy the main agent's workspace bootstrap files and runtime auth setup.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Agent
deleteDialog.message: Delete "{{name}}" from ClawClaw? This permanently deletes the agent and its ClawClaw-managed workspace, runtime, and session files from disk.

settingsDialog.title: {{name}} Settings
settingsDialog.description: Update the agent name, default model, and manage which channels belong to this agent.
settingsDialog.modelHelpInherited: This agent will inherit the default model: {{model}}. New conversations will start from this default.
settingsDialog.modelHelpSelected: This agent will default to {{model}}. Existing sessions keep their own session-level override.
settingsDialog.modelHelpCustom: After saving, new conversations use this agent model while existing sessions still follow session-level settings.
settingsDialog.channelsDescription: Configure accounts on the Connections page first, then bind specific accounts to this agent here. Multi-account connections can belong to different agents.
settingsDialog.noChannels: No channels are assigned to this agent yet.

removeChannelDialog.title: Remove Channel
removeChannelDialog.message: Unbind {{name}} from this agent? This keeps the connection config and only removes its ownership from the current agent.

bindingDialog.title: Bind Existing Connections
bindingDialog.description: Bind configured connections by account. Multi-account connections can belong to different agents.
bindingDialog.empty: There are no configured connections to bind yet. Configure accounts on the Connections page first.
bindingDialog.accountConfigured: This account is configured and ready to bind.
bindingDialog.accountNotConfigured: This account is not fully configured yet. Finish it on the Connections page first.

loadingDescription: Syncing agent configuration and channel bindings. Please wait.
